fields.label: Solid Floor
fields.description: Does the lifting equipment stand on a solid and consistent floor ?

fields.label: Third Party Service
fields.description: Is the lift equipment fully serviced by a third party?

fields.label: Hooks as per Manufacturer
fields.description: Are all hooks used in accordance with the manufacturer's recommendations?

fields.label: Capacity Board
fields.description: Is there a board showing the maximum load capacity of the lifting equipment?

fields.label: Work Area Secured
fields.description: Is the work area secured and warning labels set before work?

fields.label: Operating Arms Intact
fields.description: Are operating arms intact and clearly marked?

fields.label: Cable Wires Safe
fields.description: Is the safety of cable wires ensured and it has no defects?

fields.label: Operator Qualified
fields.description: Is the lift equipment operator qualified and aware of safety instructions?

fields.label: Controls Intact
fields.description: Are the control and guidance systems intact and clearly marked?

fields.label: Cab Protective Barrier
fields.description: Is there protective barrier on driver's cab?

fields.label: Warning Lights
fields.description: Does the mobile lifting equipment have warning lights?

fields.label: Hook Unharmed
fields.description: Is the lifting hook unharmed?

fields.label: Boom Angle Indicator
fields.description: Is there a device that shows the Boom Angle Indicator and this device is in a clear place for the winch operator?

fields.label: Boom Length / Load Radius
fields.description: Is there a device that shows the length of boom and the distance between it and the middle of the wheels of the crane (Load Radius)?

fields.label: Weather Stable
fields.description: Is weather and wind stable and does not pose risk to the work of lifting equipment?

fields.label: PPE Commitment
fields.description: Are employees committed on wearing PPE?

fields.label: Inspection Record
fields.description: Is there a record to examine and test the lifting equipment?

fields.label: Checked by Specialist
fields.description: Is the basket checked by an external specialist?

fields.label: Weight Plate
fields.description: Is there a plate on the basket showing the weight of the basket and its maximum load?

fields.label: Handrail Protection
fields.description: Is there a handrail with upper, middle and foot protection?

fields.label: Bottom Barrier
fields.description: Is there a bottom barrier to prevent the fall of equipment and materials from the basket?

fields.label: Door Locking System
fields.description: Availability of a door for the basket so that it is locked and does not open outside in the case of lifting personnel and is equipped with a device to tighten it and prevents the opening of the door during uplifting the basket?

fields.label: Upper Roof Protection
fields.description: The necessity for the upper part of the basket (roof) to protect workers from the dangers of falling materials, with the height of this ceiling being appropriate to the length of individuals?

fields.label: Tag Line Rope
fields.description: Is there a special rope (Tag Line) to be used to move the basket while lifting it?

fields.label: Helmet Used
fields.description: The necessity of the workers in the basket to use the helmet?

fields.label: Fall Protection
fields.description: Are workers insured from falling hazards and provided with safety belts and ropes?
